scope: All saved W49 calls/boundaries/held/physical arrays plus 231 retained event policies; source formulas only, no new dynamics.
thresholds: 1N is an existing diagnostic load threshold, not a new stop or qualification rule.

clocks.trajectory_time: state and same-time mj_forward force samples, 2ms grid
clocks.physical_force_time: MuJoCo mj_step forces/contact correspond to the integration evaluation, preceding its returned qpos. Force evaluation and post-integration clocks are both stored.

private_gait.raw_encoding: double bits reinterpreted as int64 by locked native source
private_gait.conclusion: Trot is active and phase advances; unchanged phase origin does not mean phase is frozen.

streams.feedback_lifecycle_conclusion: Every retained installed policy has byte-identical reference states/actions/times, K and H to first valid call 1 at t=0; reference end .35s. Source generation remains initial Stand despite changing installed IDs, scale and delta.
streams.lifecycle_scope: Exact array equality over saved event objects only; all-call old-reference use also checked through actual held query interpolation below.

recorded_same_policy_prediction_errors.note: Saved previous actually applied policy, matched next actual boundary time only; not a future replanned-trajectory comparison.

conclusions: The private gait reaches Trot at 2.002s and advances at 2Hz; no evidence here of a Stand-to-Trot or phase-clock execution failure.
Feedback reference, K and H remain exactly those of initial Stand in all retained event policies. Real held queries after .35s use the old end node.
Before 4.3s, target swing phases coexist predominantly with actual >1N foot loading. Small forward movement and repeated later support collapse do not demonstrate stable Trot.
Changing complete installation IDs does not refresh reference/K/H. This supports the scoped W50 refresh experiment, without proving it is the sole cause of collapse.
r26 native Position target is the local head reference from userdata84:96, not mission x=3.
No new dynamics or arbitrary historical plant restore performed.
